title: BitzAgentDropboxEvent
description: Schema for event payload files dropped into ~/Library/Application Support/Bitz/agent-events/

id.description: Optional unique identifier for this event.

kind.description: Lifecycle transition kind. almostDone = final-phase heads-up; warning = persistent alert (see metadata.reason); usage = context reading / activity heartbeat, never shown.

message.description: Contextual display text (e.g. 'Waiting for approval', 'All done').

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the event was generated.

metadata.description: Optional details. Keys: reason (context|loop|stall|reported), contextTokens, pendingTools, turnActive, seed, source. pendingTools, turnActive, seed and source are written by Bitz's own adapters; the drop-box does not strip them, so a script that sends them is trusted as-is.
